triage.headline: PHYSICAL TEARDOWN INSPECTION MANDATED
triage.summary_reason: Visible collision damage intersects load-bearing structural zones (e.g. quarter-panel, rocker-panel, roof, or unibody pillars). Structural chassis straightness and crumple zone integrity cannot be confirmed from 2D photographs; physical laser-measured bench inspection is strictly recommended before any total-loss or repair determination.
triage.recommended_action: Dispatch accredited field appraiser for physical inspection.

line_items.description: Unibody sheet metal restoration and pulling

assumptions: All estimates denominated in United Arab Emirates Dirham (AED).
OEM replacement parts benchmarked against UAE market catalog for brand: 'Toyota'.
All estimates reflect visible surface collision damage only.
Paint operations assume standard color blending into adjacent panels.
WARNING: Damage detected on structural load-bearing components (e.g. quarter-panel, rocker-panel). Frame pull / unibody alignment may increase costs substantially.
unknowns: Hidden suspension geometry distortion cannot be certified from 2D photographic evidence alone.
SRS airbag sensor readiness, seatbelt pretensioners, and ADAS radar calibration require OBD-II diagnostics.
Sub-surface frame rail micro-cracks or weld-seam tearing require physical undercarriage laser scanning.
Internal fluid lines, radiators, and condenser leaks require pressure testing prior to road release.

policy_guidance.title: Chassis & Structural Frame Roadworthiness Rule
policy_guidance.article: UAE Unified Motor Vehicle Insurance Policy (CBUAE Standard applied by Sukoon, Orient, ADNIC), Chapter 1, Section 2, Article 7(3)
policy_guidance.rule_summary: Relevant policy standard cited from UAE Unified Motor Vehicle Insurance Policy (CBUAE Standard applied by Sukoon, Orient, ADNIC), Chapter 1, Section 2, Article 7(3) based on matched collision criteria.
policy_guidance.statutory_text: Where accidental collision impact causes direct structural distortion, bending, or damage to the vehicle chassis, unibody floorpan, quarter-panel structural assembly, or central pillar frame such that repair cannot restore certified roadworthiness without compromising passenger compartment integrity, the vehicle shall be classified as an outright Total Loss regardless of the economic repair percentage.
